title: Data Operations Analyst
description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.


What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.


Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention


If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.


About The Role:

The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs .

Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale.


As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will:

  • Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics.
  • Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs.
  • Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time.
  • Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale.
  • Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows.
  • Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy.
  • Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances.
  • Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.
  • Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data.


You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have…

  • 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality.
  • Strong analytical judgment and comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments.
  • Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on.
  • The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data.
  • High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
  • The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability.
  • Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders.
  • Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).


Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required):

  • Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms.
  • Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows.
  • Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus.


What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
About Us

Marketing Ninjas is a cutting-edge marketing agency specializing in helping restoration companies gain more referral partners and secure exclusive leads. As a faith-driven and ninja-themed company, we operate with the highest standards, integrity, and a commitment to excellence. Our mission is to empower our clients with the tools and strategies they need to grow their businesses successfully.


Job Overview

We’re looking for a Client Success Manager (CSM) who is passionate about building relationships, ensuring client satisfaction, and driving results. The CSM will serve as the primary point of contact for our clients, ensuring they see maximum value from our services and continue to grow with us. This role requires exceptional communication skills, a strong command of English with minimal accent , and a proactive approach to client engagement.


Key Responsibilities

  • Client Onboarding & Relationship Management: Guide new clients through the onboarding process, ensuring a smooth and positive experience.
  • Ongoing Support & Strategy: Regularly check in with clients to review performance, provide strategic insights, and optimize their marketing campaigns.
  • Retention & Growth: Identify opportunities for upselling or cross-selling additional services to help clients scale their businesses.
  • Issue Resolution: Address client concerns promptly and professionally, working with internal teams to resolve any challenges.
  • Training & Education: Educate clients on best practices for using our Marketing Ninjas Lead Engine , powered by GoHighLevel .
  • Performance Monitoring: Track client success metrics and proactively reach out to offer guidance and improvements.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with our sales, marketing, and fulfillment teams using Slack, ClickUp, and GoHighLevel to ensure a seamless client experience.


What We’re Looking For

  • Experience: 2+ years in a client success, account management, or customer service role (preferably in digital marketing, SaaS, or home services industries).
  • Communication Skills:Fluent English speaker with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Minimal accent for clear and effective communication with U.S.-based clients.
  • Tech-Savvy: Experience using GoHighLevel, Slack, and ClickUp (or similar CRM and project management tools).
  • Comfortable with marketing automation and CRM tools.
  • Problem-Solving: Ability to think critically and proactively address client concerns.
  • Results-Driven: Passionate about helping clients succeed and achieving high retention rates.
  • Organized & Detail-Oriented: Ability to manage multiple clients and tasks efficiently.
  • Faith & Integrity: A commitment to conducting business with the highest ethical standards.


Why Join Marketing Ninjas?

  • Work with a mission-driven team that operates with integrity and excellence.
  • Remote work flexibility – work from anywhere!
  • Opportunities for growth in a fast-paced, ninja-themed marketing agency.
  • Competitive salary + performance-based incentives.
  • Supportive team environment with a strong focus on faith, values, and client success.


Ready to Join the Ninja Squad?

If you’re passionate about helping businesses grow , building strong client relationships , and delivering exceptional service , we’d love to hear from you! Apply today and become part of the Marketing Ninjas team.

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements
  • Net-worth monitoring;
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.
  • Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.


Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English .
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
  • not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

title: Brazil Packaging Salesperson, Remote
description:
We are a leading cosmetic packaging company. Our product offerings support beauty, personal care, and cosmetic brands with high-quality, compliant, and market-ready packaging.


Role Description


We are seeking an experienced Brazilian Cosmetic Packaging Salesperson to join our sales team. This is a full-time remote position reporting to our Sales Manager. The ideal candidate will have proven experience selling cosmetic and personal care packaging products into Brazilian markets, with a strong understanding of Brazilian business practices, regulations, and cultural nuances.


Compensation: $65,000 to $135,000 per year, depending on experience.


Responsibilities


The successful candidate will be responsible for:


- Developing and maintaining relationships with Brazilian cosmetic and personal care brands

- Identifying and pursuing new sales opportunities within Brazil's cosmetic packaging market

- Presenting cosmetic packaging solutions tailored to brand, regulatory, and consumer requirements

- Managing sales pipelines, forecasting, and reporting

- Collaborating with product development, compliance, and logistics teams to ensure customer satisfaction

- Meeting and exceeding sales targets

- Staying informed on market trends, regulations, and competitor activity in Brazilian cosmetic packaging markets


Qualifications


- Proven track record of successful B2B sales in cosmetic packaging or closely related packaging industries

- Extensive experience working with Brazilian cosmetic, beauty, or personal care markets and customers

- Strong knowledge of Brazilian cosmetic packaging regulations, standards, and labeling requirements

- Fluent in English and Portuguese

- Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills

- Ability to travel to Brazil as needed (20-30% of the time)

- Bachelor's degree in Business, Sales, or a related field

- Proficiency with CRM systems and sales tools

- Salesforce experience is a plus

title: Analista de Infraestrutura Especialista Azure
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!

Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!

Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Requisitos e Atividades


• Arquitetura Azure: Desenhar e sustentar soluções utilizando o framework de boa arquitetura da MS.

• Orquestração de Containers: Administrar e otimizar clusters AKS garantindo a saúde, monitoramento e o ciclo de vida das aplicações.

• Modernização: Liderar a transição de workloads legados (On-premises/VMs) para arquiteturas modernas (PaaS, IaaS, SaaS e Containers).

• Automação e DevOps: Evoluir as rotinas de automação para uma cultura de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC), utilizando Terraform ou Bicep.

• Identidade e Segurança: Conhecimento em B2C, EntraID garantindo políticas de acesso seguro (Conditional Access, RBAC).

• Gestão de Performance: Monitorar proativamente a saúde do ambiente Azure (Azure Monitor/Log Analytics/App Insights)


Habilidades Técnicas:

• Experiência: Mínimo de 10 anos em infraestrutura de TI, com vivência comprovada em ambientes robustos e missões críticas.

• Domínio Microsoft: Sólido conhecimento em AKS, ferramentas dos ambientes IaaS, PaaS e SaaS.

• Cloud: Experiência prática em administração de recursos Azure (Networking, App Services e Storage).

• Automação: Expertise em Azure CLI, Terraform para automação de processos e gestão de configurações.

• Resiliência: Experiência em planos de Disaster Recovery (DR) e atuação em crises com elaboração de laudos de causa raiz (RCA).


Formato de trabalho: Home office


E temos também o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!

Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Requisitos e Atividades


• Arquitetura Azure: Desenhar e sustentar soluções utilizando o framework de boa arquitetura da MS.

• Orquestração de Containers: Administrar e otimizar clusters AKS garantindo a saúde, monitoramento e o ciclo de vida das aplicações.

• Modernização: Liderar a transição de workloads legados (On-premises/VMs) para arquiteturas modernas (PaaS, IaaS, SaaS e Containers).

• Automação e DevOps: Evoluir as rotinas de automação para uma cultura de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC), utilizando Terraform ou Bicep.

• Identidade e Segurança: Conhecimento em B2C, EntraID garantindo políticas de acesso seguro (Conditional Access, RBAC).

• Gestão de Performance: Monitorar proativamente a saúde do ambiente Azure (Azure Monitor/Log Analytics/App Insights)


Habilidades Técnicas:

• Experiência: Mínimo de 10 anos em infraestrutura de TI, com vivência comprovada em ambientes robustos e missões críticas.

• Domínio Microsoft: Sólido conhecimento em AKS, ferramentas dos ambientes IaaS, PaaS e SaaS.

• Cloud: Experiência prática em administração de recursos Azure (Networking, App Services e Storage).

• Automação: Expertise em Azure CLI, Terraform para automação de processos e gestão de configurações.

• Resiliência: Experiência em planos de Disaster Recovery (DR) e atuação em crises com elaboração de laudos de causa raiz (RCA).


Formato de trabalho: Home office

title: Recruiter (Fluent English)
description:
Recruiter - Fluent in English | Remote


(POSITION TO AT LEAST 2 YEAR EXPERIENCED RECRUITER)


At Bluedot BPO Solutions, we connect top LATAM talent with high-performing U.S. teams. We are looking for an experienced and strategic Executive Recruiter to lead end-to-end hiring processes and support corporate talent acquisition for international clients.

This fully remote role offers daily exposure to the U.S. market and a clear growth path for professionals who want to build a long-term career in Talent Acquisition and HR leadership.


What We Offer


  • Compensation of R$5,000 + bonuses in USD
  • 100% remote, working directly with U.S. teams
  • Monday to Friday, 12PM – 21 PM (BRT)
  • Long-term position
  • Fast-track growth opportunities (Senior Recruiter, Lead, Manager)
  • International exposure and multicultural environment
  • Structured training and continuous coaching


Your Responsibilities


  • Manage full-cycle recruitment for corporate and strategic roles
  • Partner with stakeholders to align candidate profiles and hiring needs
  • Source, screen, and interview candidates for the U.S. market
  • Utilize tools such as LinkedIn Recruiter and ATS platforms
  • Manage and maintain healthy candidate pipelines
  • Ensure an excellent candidate experience end-to-end
  • Maintain consistent communication with hiring managers and candidates
  • Support strategic hiring initiatives for clients and internal teams


What We’re Looking For


  • 2+ year of experience with Recruitment/Hunting in the American market
  • Proven experience in end-to-end recruitment
  • Strong English communication skills (professional level)
  • Highly organized and able to manage multiple requisitions
  • Detail-oriented, proactive, and delivery-focused
  • Comfortable in fast-paced environments


Nice to Have


  • Background in corporate or executive recruitment
  • Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter, Dynamics, or other ATS
  • Experience in high-volume or fast-paced hiring environments
  • Experience working with global stakeholders
  • Experience recruiting for international or U.S. clients is a strong plus



Technical Requirements


  • Two monitors
  • Laptop with i5/i7 (or equivalent) + 12GB RAM
  • High-speed internet
  • Headset with microphone
  • Quiet home office


Build your international career in Recruitment.


Work directly with U.S. teams and grow in a structured, high-performance environment.

title: Analista de Negócios de Tecnologia Sr.
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo?

Então essa é a sua chance!



Buscamos: Analista de Negócios de Tecnologia Sr.



Resumo:

Estamos em busca de um profissional com profundo conhecimento em metodologias ágeis, experiência comprovada na coleta de requisitos e atuação como Scrum Master, além de um backgroud em desenvolvimento de sistemas. O candidato ideal deve demonstrar habilidades em liderança de projetos e ser capaz de atuar como facilitador de equipes ágeis, assegurando a entrega de soluções de alta qualidade.



Atribuições :

  • Liderar projetos: Coordenar equipes e garantir a entrega de soluções de alta qualidade dentro dos prazos estabelecidos.


  • Auxiliar na definição e levantamento de requisitos: Elaborar e documentar histórias de usuário, assegurando que estejam claras, completas e alinhadas com as necessidades do negócio.


  • Elaborar e monitorar status reports: Acompanhar KPIs e métricas de desempenho dos projetos, fornecendo informações precisas sobre o progresso e as áreas de melhoria.


  • Fornecer suporte técnico ao time de desenvolvimento: Ajudar na resolução de problemas técnicos, apoiar a tomada de decisões e facilitar a comunicação eficaz entre os membros da equipe.


  • Colaborar com diversas áreas interdependentes: Trabalhar com diferentes equipes e stakeholders, tanto dentro quanto fora do departamento de TI, para garantir que os projetos atendam às expectativas e requisitos das partes interessadas.


  • Atuar como Scrum Master: Facilitar a execução das reuniões e eventos ágeis, promovendo a adoção das melhores práticas e garantindo a eficiência dos processos ágeis.


  • Prestar consultoria e suporte aos clientes internos: Orientar sobre as regras de negócio dos sistemas em utilização e assegurar que as soluções atendam às suas necessidades.



Requisitos :

  • Experiência mínima de 6 anos como Scrum Master ou analista de desenvolvimento, com atuação em levantamento de requisitos.
  • Formação superior completa ou cursando último ano em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Análise de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas de tecnologia.



Conhecimento técnico fundamental:

  • Experiência prévia como Scrum Master ou em um papel similar de liderança de projetos ágeis;
  • Sólido conhecimento e experiência em desenvolvimento de sistemas;
  • Experiência em liderança e gestão de projetos;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de gestão ágil, como Azure DevOps.



Conhecimento técnico desejável:

  • Conhecimento básico na plataforma Azure (provisionamento, acesso e gerenciamento de recursos);
  • Conhecimento de práticas DevOps (containers, integração e deploy contínuo);
  • Conhecimento básico de Databricks;
  • Certificação de SCRUM Master.



Idiomas:

  • Inglês avançado fundamental;
  • Espanhol é um diferencial.




O que oferecemos?

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:



  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação
  • Horário Flexível
  • Modelo de trabalho remoto
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica
  • Convênio Farmácia
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados
  • Previdência Privada
  • Licença Maternidade com duração de 6 meses
  • Licença Paternidade estendida com duração de 20 dias
  • Licença Maternidade/Paternidade para casais homoafetivos
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras
  • Programa de Qualidade de vida: Convênio com academias, palestras sobre temas relevantes, vacinação contra a gripe; Programa Global de Assistência ao colaborador e seus familiares (assistência jurídica, psicológica ou financeira) e muito mais
  • Programa de Mobilidade Interna: valorizamos talentos internos e por isso as vagas disponíveis são divulgadas internamente possibilitando ao colaborador mudar de área ou divisão diferente da que atua



Se o seu perfil corresponde aos nossos valores e objetivos, deixe seu currículo conosco e não perca a chance de fazer parte de nossa equipe. Esperamos por você!



No IBOPE a diversidade faz parte do negócio, gerando inovação e resultados. Não fazemos distinção de raça, religião, nacionalidade, gênero, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, idade, deficiência, gravidez, estado civil ou qualquer outra forma de discriminação.

title: AI Automation Specialist | Ecommerce (Full-time Remote, BR)
description:
Carepod is a growing premium humidifier brand operating in the US, Canada, and Australia . We’re looking for an AI Automation Specialist to eliminate manual work and build smart, reliable workflows across the business.



What You’ll Do


  • Build AI-powered automations for marketing, operation, CS, and reporting system throughout company
  • Connect tools like Shopify, Asana, Google Workspace, Zendesk

  • 3+ years in automation / ops / systems roles
  • Hands-on experience with no-code / low-code tools
  • Strong business process thinking
  • Clear English communication
  • Bonus: ecommerce, Python, security-minded builds



How to Apply


  • Apply with your resume or LinkedIn profile.

title: Salesforce Business System Analyst
description:
Job Title: Salesforce Business Systems Analyst (BSA)

Location: LATAM

Duration: 6-12months

Job Summary:

We are looking for a Salesforce Business Systems Analyst (BSA) with strong experience in gathering business requirements, translating them into functional specifications, and supporting Salesforce implementation and enhancements. The ideal candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, product owners, and technical teams to deliver scalable Salesforce solutions that support business processes.

Key Responsibilities:

·Work with business stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document business requirements for Salesforce implementations and enhancements.

·Translate business needs into functional requirements, user stories, and process flows .

·Act as a bridge between business teams and technical teams to ensure accurate implementation of requirements.

·Configure and support Salesforce features including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, workflows, validation rules, reports, and dashboards .

·Participate in solution design discussions and recommend best practices within the Salesforce ecosystem.

·Support UAT (User Acceptance Testing) by preparing test cases, coordinating with stakeholders, and ensuring requirements are met.

·Assist in data migration, integration requirements, and system documentation .

·Provide production support and troubleshooting for Salesforce issues.

·Maintain clear documentation including BRDs, FRDs, user stories, and process diagrams .

·Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive continuous improvement and system optimization .

Required Qualifications:

·3–6 years of experience as a Business Analyst with Salesforce platform exposure .

·Strong understanding of Salesforce Sales Cloud and/or Service Cloud .

·Experience with requirements gathering, documentation, and stakeholder management .

·Knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies .

·Ability to create user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications .

·Experience with Salesforce reporting, dashboards, and basic configuration .

·Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills

title: Virtual Executive Assistant – Family Owned Business Group
description:
Summary

We are a family-owned business group overseeing a diversified portfolio of ventures across healthcare (medical practices), luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment production .

Our organization supports multiple senior executives who operate at the intersection of medicine, entrepreneurship, real estate, travel, and the performing arts . We are seeking a highly proactive, detail-oriented Virtual Executive Assistant to provide executive-level administrative and operational support across the group and help streamline day-to-day execution as our businesses continue to grow.


This is a unique opportunity to work closely with leadership across multiple industries , gaining exposure to complex operations, high-level decision-making, and creative as well as clinical environments.


Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimize executive calendars across multiple businesses, including coordinating meetings across time zones and balancing competing priorities
  • Serve as a primary communication liaison , screening and prioritizing emails, calls, and messages to ensure timely and appropriate responses
  • Coordinate travel arrangements including flights, accommodations, ground transportation, and detailed itineraries for business and personal travel
  • Prepare meeting materials , agendas, briefing notes, and follow-up summaries to ensure action items are tracked and completed
  • Conduct research on vendors, partners, venues, travel options, market opportunities, and industry trends to support executive decision-making
  • Manage relationships with vendors and external service providers , including medical offices, travel partners, production vendors, accountants, and legal teams
  • Organize and maintain digital filing systems across multiple entities, ensuring documents are secure, accessible, and well categorized
  • Assist with special projects , including event coordination, content creation, process documentation, operational improvements, and cross-business initiatives
  • Handle personal administrative tasks as needed to support executive productivity and work-life balance

Qualifications

  • 2–5 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Virtual Assistant, or similar high-level administrative role supporting senior leaders
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to represent executives professionally across industries
  • Highly resourceful and high-agency , with a demonstrated ability to anticipate needs and solve problems independently
  • Advanced proficiency with productivity tools including Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets) , Zapier, Zoom, and project management platforms
  • Strong organizational skills with experience managing complex schedules and competing priorities
  • Proven track record of maintaining strict confidentiality and exercising sound judgment with sensitive information
  • Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated home office setup
  • Availability to work during overlapping U.S. Eastern Time hours

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting founders, physicians, or executives across multiple businesses
  • Familiarity with CRM systems, expense management, invoicing, and basic bookkeeping
  • Experience coordinating events, travel, or live productions
  • Comfort working in both clinical / professional and creative / entertainment environments
  • Bilingual capabilities (Spanish is a plus but not required)
  • Experience with Notion, Hubspot and Zapier

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation commensurate with experience
  • Opportunity to work directly with senior leadership across healthcare, luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment
  • Exposure to a diversified business portfolio , not a single company role
  • Flexible, remote-first work environment with an emphasis on results over hours
  • Long-term growth potential for the right candidate who becomes a trusted operational partner

  • Advanced proficiency with productivity tools including Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets) , Zapier, Zoom, and project management platforms
  • Strong organizational skills with experience managing complex schedules and competing priorities
  • Proven track record of maintaining strict confidentiality and exercising sound judgment with sensitive information
  • Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated home office setup
  • Availability to work during overlapping U.S. Eastern Time hours

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting founders, physicians, or executives across multiple businesses
  • Familiarity with CRM systems, expense management, invoicing, and basic bookkeeping
  • Experience coordinating events, travel, or live productions
  • Comfort working in both clinical / professional and creative / entertainment environments
  • Bilingual capabilities (Spanish is a plus but not required)
  • Experience with Notion, Hubspot and Zapier

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation commensurate with experience
  • Opportunity to work directly with senior leadership across healthcare, luxury travel, and Broadway / live entertainment
  • Exposure to a diversified business portfolio , not a single company role
  • Flexible, remote-first work environment with an emphasis on results over hours
  • Long-term growth potential for the right candidate who becomes a trusted operational partner

title: Senior Technical Analyst
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for an experienced Senior Technical Analyst with minimum 7 years of experience with Solaris/AIX/Linux, WebSphere, WebLogic or JBoss and various middleware infrastructure technologies.


Responsibilities:


· Evaluate, design, document, install, test, implement, monitors and maintain complex UNIX/Linux based applications such as GPP, GCP, Total Payments, and infrastructure solutions

· Configuring and support of production, testing and development environments (Solaris/AIX/Linux)

· Troubleshooting, Preparing, updating, and maintaining technical documentation and RFPs

· Capacity planning, DR configuration, and High Availability implementation and testing

· Evaluate, recommend, installs and configure tools for event monitoring, capacity planning, performance monitoring on UNIX/Linux systems providing automated 24/7 production application and system monitoring

· Conduct technical training


Must-Have Skills:


· Relevant academic background

· Good understanding of GPP SP & Total Payments deployment architecture

· Minimum 7 years of technical work experience on UNIX/Linux/Cloud environment. This could include development, technical QA, and application implementation/support

· Systems troubleshooting and resolution of system and application problems

· Excellent customer facing, communication and interpersonal skills

· Experience with the following:

o J2EE Application Servers – WebSphere / WebLogic / JBoss (including performance benchmark analysis)

o Microsoft Azure or Amazon EC2

o Hazelcast

o Oracle DB (including performance benchmark analysis)

o IBM MQ

o UNIX Shell or Perl Scripting and/or Web Application Server scripting

o Elastic Search

o Kafka (a plus)

o Understanding of UNIX high availability and clustering

· 50% overlap with US hours to support offshore client

· Extensive travel might be required

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

  • Dental Plan
  • Life insurance

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Engenharia de Dados AWS
description:
Já conhece a GFT?

Com mais de 40 anos de mercado e localizada em 20 países, a GFT emprega mais de 12.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo quase 5.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

Promovemos uma cultura de desenvolvimento e crescimento pautadas no nosso pilar de Continuous Scaled Learning porque acreditamos o uso inteligente da tecnologia é a chave para o sucesso nesse mundo digital.


O que buscamos:

Profissional de nível Sênior que atue com Dados e AWS.



Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Experiência avançada em AWS e seus principais serviços para engenharia de dados (S3, Glue, Lambda, Redshift, DynamoDB, Athena, etc.).
  • Domínio de linguagens de programação como Python para manipulação e processamento de dados.
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de orquestração de dados, como Apache Airflow ou AWS Step Functions.
  • Experiência em banco de dados relacional e não relacional (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB).
  • Familiaridade com boas práticas de segurança em ambientes AWS (IAM, KMS, criptografia de dados).
  • Experiência em soluções de streaming de dados (Kafka, Kinesis).
  • Conhecimento em controle de versão e pipelines de CI/CD utilizando ferramentas como GitHub, Jenkins, ou CodePipeline.


Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.


O que oferecemos:

  • Cartão multi-benefícios – você escolhe como e onde utilizar;
  • Bolsas de Estudos para cursos de Graduação, Pós, MBA e Idiomas;
  • Programas de incentivo à Certificações;
  • Horário de trabalho flexível;
  • Plano personalizado de carreira e possibilidade de carreira internacional;
  • Salários competitivos;
  • Avaliação de desempenho anual com possibilidade de bonificação;
  • Gympass;
  • Previdência Privada;
  • Auxílio-Creche;
  • Assistência Médica;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Seguro de Vida.



Big enough to deliver – small enough to care.

#VempraGFT

#VamosVoarJuntos

#ProudToBeGFT

title: College-Level Chemistry Tutor
description:
We are looking for tutors to solve college-level Chemistry questions in English. These questions are submitted by students, who expect a response in less than 24 hours.


Tutors in this project work in freelance mode and can decide the number of hours they wish to work.


Do you prefer to work in the morning, in the evening, for a few hours or many hours? The choice is yours. You can log in at any time to help students. In addition, you can work from anywhere, as long as you have a computer with a reliable Internet connection.


We need tutors who can start immediately!


Characteristics


Payment in dollars.

Type of contract: freelance/self-employed.

Schedule: Flexible, free choice

Start: Immediate

Duration: Indefinite


Requirements


  • Ability to solve university-level questions in at least one of the following subjects:
  • General Chemistry
  • Organic Chemistry
  • Student or graduate of a university course whose curriculum includes at least one of the subjects listed in the previous point.
  • Computer with an Internet connection.
  • No criminal record.


About LatinHire


Founded in 2003, LatinHire is a company specialising in managing teams of experts for distance learning institutions. Its clients include some of the world's most prestigious education startups.

title: Full Stack Developer Sênior (Plataforma)
description:
A Jusfy está em busca de uma Pessoa Desenvolvedora Full Stack Sênior, com forte viés em backend , para compor o time! Somos uma startup jurídica que busca constantemente soluções para facilitar a vida dos advogados e advogadas do Brasil. Atuamos na área de tecnologia, desenvolvendo produtos e ferramentas que auxiliam na produtividade diária dos nossos clientes.


Somos uma empresa jovem e muito promissora. Alcançamos resultados expressivos de crescimento nos últimos anos e sabemos que temos ainda muito mais para conquistar.


Buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer parte dessa trajetória junto conosco.

Aqui, a Engenharia é tratada como cidadã de primeira classe: você terá voz ativa, participará das decisões estratégicas junto a Produto e Design e terá autonomia para propor e construir soluções.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e evoluir serviços backend utilizando Node.js, Java e Python
  • Desenhar e sustentar soluções utilizando APIs REST e Arquitetura Orientada a Eventos (EDA)
  • Participar de decisões arquiteturais avaliando trade-offs entre escalabilidade, performance e velocidade de entrega
  • Desenvolver e manter interfaces em ReactJS e TypeScript integradas aos serviços de backend
  • Realizar code reviews construtivos e contribuir para a evolução técnica do time
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores(as) menos experientes
  • Garantir boas práticas de engenharia: código limpo, testável, escalável e bem documentado
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua da arquitetura e qualidade dos sistemas


Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida como Engenheiro(a) de Software Sênior com forte atuação em backend
  • Experiência com Node.js, Java ou Python
  • Capacidade de atuar em ambientes poliglotas e transitar entre diferentes linguagens
  • Experiência com APIs REST e Arquitetura Orientada a Eventos (EDA)
  • Experiência com ReactJS e TypeScript no desenvolvimento de interfaces
  • Domínio de bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais
  • Experiência com Docker, Git e pipelines de CI/CD
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas considerando trade-offs de produto e arquitetura


Desejável

  • Experiência com soluções financeiras ou fintech (pagamentos, billing, recorrência, webhooks)
  • Sólida base em System Design e arquitetura de sistemas distribuídos
  • Experiência com testes automatizados (unitários, integração e e2e)
  • Vivência em ambientes de startup de alto crescimento
  • Familiaridade com cultura DevOps


Modelo de Contratação

PJ


Oferecemos

  • Cartão flexível ajuda de custo R$265,00
  • Bônus (Participação nos Resultados)
  • Day Off de aniversário
  • Descanso remunerado
  • Rotina remota de trabalho
  • Ambiente de trabalho descontraído e inovador
  • Oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos desafiadores e com grande impacto

title: Python Engineer - ArcGIS Pro
description:
Python Engineer - ArcGIS Pro

Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


As an experienced developer, you will work in a dynamic team on creating innovative solutions and implementing solutions from coding to testing to production deployment support

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Digest requirements from the product team and work on solutions with performance and scalability features;
  • Implement solutions from coding to testing to production deployment support;
  • Follow agile processes and participate actively in all development phases.

Essential Skills


  • Expertise in ArcGIS Pro;
  • Proficiency in development in Python;
  • Proficiency in Oracle SQL;
  • Experience with pyTest;
  • Experience with Django and Flask frameworks;
  • Experience with Linux environments;
  • Experience with modeling, producing, and consuming web services-based APIs (RESTful).

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases.
  • Experience with Salesforce integration via APIs;
  • Experience with Docker;
  • Experience with Jenkins;
  • Experience with OpenShift;
  • Knowledge of Agile development (e.g. using Scrum, Kanban, Lean, XP, etc.);
  • Familiarity with principles of distributed systems.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Rubber Engineers, Tyre Industries
description:
Company Description

SUNSET TIRES CORPORATION LIMITED, established on July 18th, 1988, has a rich legacy in the import, export, and distribution of tires, tubes, wheels, and lubricants. Known for its commitment to quality and service, the company is a trusted leader in the tire industry. SUNSET TIRES has built a strong reputation by delivering premium products to clients worldwide, emphasizing reliability and innovation.

Role Description

This is a contract, remote role for Rubber Engineers specializing in the tire industry. Key responsibilities include designing, developing, and testing tire rubber formulations, ensuring quality and performance standards, analyzing raw materials, and modifying processes to meet client requirements. The role also involves collaborating with cross-functional teams to optimize product performance and manufacturing efficiency.

Qualifications
  • Expertise in Rubber Engineering, Polymer Science, and Material Development
  • Strong knowledge of tire rubber formulations and testing methodologies
  • Experience in technical analysis and process optimization
  • Proficiency in industry-standard software and equipment for rubber testing and development
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for reporting and cross-functional collaboration
  • Bachelor’s or higher degree in Polymer Engineering, Material Science, Chemical Engineering, or a related field
  • Experience in the tire or rubber industry is highly preferred

title: .Net Developer
description:
Job Title: .NET Developer

Location: Remote (Brazil-based only)

Salary: $3,500-4,500 per month

Job Type: Contract

Experience Level: Senior Level


About the Role:

We are seeking a skilled .NET Developer to join our growing development team. This fully remote role is open to candidates based in Brazil and offers the opportunity to work on modern application development projects in a supportive and agile environment.

You will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining high-quality software solutions using .NET / .NET Core , SQL , and AWS technologies. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and a strong understanding of application development lifecycle is essential.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain applications using .NET/.NET Core and related technologies
  • Work with SQL databases to design schemas, write queries, and optimize performance
  • Develop and maintain cloud-based applications using AWS
  • Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines for streamlined deployment processes
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features
  • Troubleshoot and resolve application issues in a timely manner
  • Write clean, scalable, and maintainable code following best practices
  • Contribute to improving development processes and methodologies
  • On-call responsibilities (usually every 3 weeks)


Required Skills & Experience:

  • Fluent English
  • Experience with Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions
  • Minimum of 3 years' experience in software development with .NET / .NET Core
  • Strong experience with SQL and relational databases
  • Strong exp with unit testing (to be highlighted in CV)
  • Strong exp with Kubernetes (to be highlighted in CV)
  • Hands-on experience with AWS
  • Experience with Docker
  • Knowledge of CodeQL
  • Experience working with CI/CD tools and workflows
  • Solid understanding of application development principles and best practices
  • Ability to work independently in a remote team environment
  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills


Nice to Have:


  • Familiarity with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD)
  • Exposure to ChatGPT / GPT-4 development or integration of large language models into applications


What We Offer:

  • Fully remote working environment (Brazil-based)
  • Flexible working hours
  • Opportunity to work on modern cloud-native applications

title: Arquiteto de soluções Azure/IA
description:
A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.


O que Buscamos?


Arquiteto de soluções Azure/IA


Descrição:


Estamos procurando um(a) Arquiteto de soluções Azure/IA para ajudar clientes a levar suas aplicações com IA para escala de produção no Azure. Nessa função voltada ao cliente, você liderará engajamentos técnicos em design, construção e operações, removendo impedimentos e acelerando a adoção de Azure AI, App Services, GitHub e plataformas de dados. Como parte da equipe Cloud + AI Apps, você conduzirá engajamentos aproveitando IP Repetível e mecanismos de execução existentes, com responsabilidade por excelência na entrega, crescimento de consumo e implantação bem-sucedida para o cliente.


Responsabilidades:

  • Interagir com líderes de TI e de negócios do cliente para entender as prioridades de aplicações, dados e IA, e desenhar soluções seguras e escaláveis que gerem valor de negócio e satisfação do cliente.
  • Estar credenciado(a) e certificado(a) para entregar com proficiência avançada e de nível especialista em cargas de trabalho prioritárias, incluindo Azure AI Foundry, AKS, App Service, Cosmos DB, Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, APIM e GitHub.
  • Liderar engajamentos técnicos em design de arquitetura, Provas de Conceito (POCs) e Produtos Mínimos Viáveis (MVPs) para acelerar a adoção de Azure AI, App Services, GitHub e plataformas de dados.
  • Ser responsável pelos resultados de entrega técnica ponta a ponta, garantindo completude e precisão dos planos de consumo e de sucesso do cliente em colaboração com o CSAM.
  • Conduzir as próximas melhores ações e gerar pipeline incremental a partir de cada engajamento, alinhando-se às prioridades do Unified Enterprise Support (ES).
  • Entregar propriedade intelectual (IP) reutilizável e contribuir para o desenvolvimento centralizado de IP para acelerar a implantação e alcançar os resultados-alvo.
  • Fornecer supervisão de entrega e suporte a escalonamentos (escalation) para engajamentos-chave de Factory em projetos de IA e de Inovação em Apps.
  • Atuar como a Voz do Cliente, compartilhando insights e feedback com as equipes de engenharia para influenciar melhorias de produto e remover impedimentos à adoção.
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento de competências do cliente por meio de workshops técnicos, atividades de readiness e recomendações que garantam desempenho, manutenibilidade e confiabilidade da solução.
  • Manter profunda expertise técnica e permanecer atualizado(a) sobre tendências de desenvolvimento no Azure, IA, GitHub e cloud-native, contribuindo também para comunidades técnicas internas e externas.


Contratação CLT

Trabalho Hibrido (Viagens exporaticas)



O que oferecemos?

  • Vale Refeição ou Alimentação;
  • Assistência Médica e Assistência Odontológica;
  • Auxílio creche;
  • Convênio com Farmácia;
  • Parcerias com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas;
  • Parceria de descontos com Seguro Auto e Residência;
  • Gympass;
  • Seguro de Vida;


Promovemos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e acolhedor. Não fazemos distinção por raça, cor, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade. Todas as candidaturas serão consideradas. O seu interesse em participar deste processo seletivo, automaticamente consente, autoriza e concorda que a PSM COMPANY, no papel de CONTROLADORA, tome decisões referentes ao tratamento de seus dados pessoais para esta finalidade específica, em conformidade com a Lei nº 13.709 – Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD).

title: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo

NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.

NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.

We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.

Role and responsibilities

The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.

The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.


Primary roles and responsibilities include:

Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management

  • Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
  • Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
  • Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
  • Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.

Eligibility, due diligence & agreements

  • Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
  • Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
  • Lead closure of contract signatures.
  • Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system

(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).

Reforestation delivery enablement

  • Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
  • Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
  • Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
  • Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).

Stakeholder engagement and safeguards

  • Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
  • Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism.
  • Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
  • Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.

Reporting

  • Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
  • Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.

Teamwork and culture

  • Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
  • Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.


Skills and attributes

To perform successfully in this role, you will have:

  • A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
  • Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
  • Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
  • Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
  • A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
  • A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
  • Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
  • A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.


Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.


Location

  • Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia


Submission instructions

  • Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
  • Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: DevOps Engineer SR
description:
DevOps Engineer SR


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


This is a highly sensitive and mission‑critical role with admin‑level access to the core platform. The ideal professional is exceptionally reliable, security‑minded, technically strong, and trustworthy, ensuring the stability, performance, and resilience of cloud infrastructure supporting large‑scale production systems.

You will lead cloud operations, infrastructure automation, observability, and performance optimization across AWS environments, ensuring secure, cost‑efficient, and scalable solutions.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Manage and optimize AWS infrastructure including ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;
  • Design, deploy, and maintain Infrastructure as Code using AWS CloudFormation;
  • Own and enhance CI/CD pipelines using CircleCI or similar tools, including automated deployments, rollback strategies, and environment versioning;
  • Implement and maintain observability frameworks leveraging tools such as New Relic and Splunk for monitoring, logging, alerting, and incident response;
  • Diagnose and resolve performance bottlenecks across databases, services, network layers, and workloads;
  • Lead AWS cost‑optimization initiatives, ensuring performance and reliability remain uncompromised;
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional engineering, architecture, and operations teams to support deployments, troubleshoot issues, and evolve platform capabilities;
  • Ensure best‑in‑class security practices for sensitive production environments, including IAM hardening and compliance with internal controls.


Essential Skills


  • Expertise with ECS (Fargate & EC2), EC2, RDS/Aurora, S3, IAM, ALB/NLB, Route 53, CloudFront, and WAF;
  • Strong experience with CloudFormation for managing AWS infrastructure;
  • Hands-on experience with CircleCI or similar tools, including deployment automation and rollback strategies;
  • Proficiency with monitoring and logging tools like New Relic, and Splunk;
  • Ability to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks in database queries, configurations, and infrastructure;
  • Experience reducing AWS costs while maintaining or improving system reliability and performans.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Hands-on experience operating Amazon Aurora MySQL/Postgres in production environments, including version upgrade procedures, performance tuning, and troubleshooting;
  • Strong understanding of Aurora architecture, read replicas, automated backups, point-in-time recovery, failover mechanisms, and high availability patterns;
  • Proven track record performing database version upgrades in production with minimal downtime, including compatibility testing, replication management, and performance validation.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: English Teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Senior Backend (Node.js) Engineer
description:
About Us

Founded in 2019 by two best friends, Jon and Eli, XILO set out to revolutionize the insurance industry by solving its biggest challenges. Eli, a brokerage owner, brought invaluable industry expertise, while Jon, an experienced software engineer, saw an opportunity to innovate using technology. Initially launched as a vertical SaaS solution addressing core quoting challenges, XILO has since evolved into a trailblazing Vertical AI company leveraging the latest AI technology to transform the industry. By layering cutting-edge AI solutions onto its SaaS platform, XILO is driving innovation far beyond its original vision. Having recently closed our Series A funding round, XILO is growing rapidly and seeking talented individuals who want to do career-defining work in a mission-driven startup that’s at the forefront of AI innovation.


About The Role

As a Senior Backend Engineer , you’ll be designing and architecting scalable solutions , creating robust APIs, and building new microservices from the ground up —while also improving and optimizing our existing systems. This isn’t just another engineering role. We’re solving real, painful inefficiencies in the insurance space – problems so frustrating that prospects have nearly teared up during sales calls, realizing how much time and effort we could save them. What we’re building isn’t just an upgrade – it’s a fundamental shift in how agencies operate .


What You’ll Do:

  • Architect and develop scalable TypeScript microservices powering XILO’s platform.
  • You’ll have the opportunity to work where your strengths shine and contribute to:
  • AI Agents – Automating complex decision-making and workflows
  • OCR & Document Processing – Extracting, structuring, and analyzing key insights from insurance documents
  • Intelligent Data Mapping – Aggregating and linking all relevant data into a centralized, dynamic user profile
  • Advanced Insurance Operations & CRM – The AI-powered backbone of agencies, seamlessly tracking, managing, and integrating customer data across tools and workflows while replacing outdated, manual processes
  • Forms Builder & Smart Data Entry – A Typeform-like system built for insurance, enabling error-proof, collaborative submissions – fill once, apply everywhere
  • Optimize system performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, frontend, data science) to deliver seamless integrations.
  • Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented team culture.
  • Implement best practices for API security, data privacy, and maintainability.


What we’re looking for

  • 7+ years of backend development experience, with a strong foundation in TypeScript and JavaScript.
  • Strong experience with Node.js
  • Proven expertise in designing and developing software product features, with a focus on scalability, performance, and maintainability.
  • Proven expertise in REST API design – including authentication, performance optimization, and security best practices.
  • Experience with XML and SOAP-based integrations, commonly used in the insurance industry.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Nest.js, leveraging its modular architecture for scalable backend services.
  • Familiarity with NX monorepos for structuring and maintaining large-scale applications.
  • Cloud deployment experience on Heroku and AWS, including CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure management.
  • Deep understanding of database management, ORM usage (e.g., TypeORM, Prisma, Sequelize), and zero-downtime migration strategies.
  • Experience designing and implementing microservices architectures, including inter-service communication, data consistency, and service decoupling.
  • Bonus: Full-stack experience with modern frontend frameworks like Angular.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).


What we offer

  • Collaborative and innovative work environment
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Budget for English lessons.


Why Join XILO?

  • A great tech startup – Small, fast-moving, and driven by real impact
  • Endless career growth – Help shape the team, tech, and company as we scale
  • Strong leadership & backing – Work alongside experienced founders and tier 1 silicon-valley VCs



Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: People Business Partner
description:
This role is part of the People Success area and acts as a strategic partner to leaders and teams, ensuring a high-impact, culture-aligned employee experience throughout the full journey. The role owns end-to-end onboarding and offboarding processes, provides ongoing support and coaching to organizational leaders, and leads initiatives related to culture, benefits, and corporate social responsibility (CSR), always with a continuous improvement and scalability mindset.


What You'll Do:

  • Own and lead end-to-end onboarding and offboarding processes, ensuring a smooth, consistent, and culture-aligned employee experience.
  • Act as a strategic partner to leaders, providing ongoing guidance, coaching, and support on team health, performance, engagement, and complex people situations.
  • Serve as a trusted point of contact for employees and managers, delivering high-quality internal client support with a strong service mindset.
  • Drive and execute culture and engagement initiatives that strengthen Qubika’s values and employee experience across teams.
  • Identify improvement opportunities through feedback and data, and implement scalable solutions to enhance People processes and the overall employee lifecycle.


What we expect from you:


  • Experience working for Brazilian companies in Brazil. SP/Curtiva Preferred
  • 4+ years of experience in HRBP/People Partner/HR Generalist roles with strong leadership exposure within tech companies .
  • Bachelor’s degree in Psychology, Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field; advanced degree is a plus.
  • Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal). Fluent Spanish nice to have.
  • Experience working in dynamic, multicultural and/or distributed environments is a plus.
  • Previous experience with Workday is a plus.


Soft Skills

  • Clear, empathetic, and assertive communication.
  • Strong teamwork and collaboration skills.
  • Strategic mindset with strong execution.
  • Autonomy, prioritization, and multi-stakeholder management.
  • Analytical thinking and Data-driven approach to People practices.


What we offer:

  • Exciting and innovative projects for disruptive start-ups and world-class companies.
  • A creative working environment with a positive and collaborative atmosphere within an open-minded community.
  • A senior team that offers mentorship opportunities to help you excel in your career.
  • Enjoy a range of benefits at Qubika, including flexible work hours, ongoing skill development, language lessons, travel opportunities, engaging activities, expert talks, and more.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Company Description

At Company 86, we specialize in cybersecurity, digital transformation, and advanced AI implementation to deliver measurable and secure results for our clients. With decades of real-world experience, we focus on practical and future-ready outcomes through strategy, design, and delivery. Our mission is to ensure successful, transformative solutions that meet the evolving needs of businesses. We are committed to innovation and delivering cutting-edge expertise through our core principles: Cyber, Transformation, and AI.


Role Description

I’m working with a small, high-trust team that’s hiring 2 Staff / Senior Staff Software Engineer  — someone who thrives in ambiguity, takes real ownership, and prefers defining problems rather than waiting for tickets. This is not  a “tasks + Jira board” role. You’d be shaping architecture, shipping meaningful systems, and using agentic coding tools (Cursor / Claude Code, etc.) as true force multipliers — not crutches.

You’d be a great fit if you:

 • Own outcomes end-to-end — not just code

 • Work comfortably across Python + TypeScript / React

 • Have experience integrating LLM APIs  (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, etc.)

 • Enjoy making smart trade-offs with imperfect info

 • Prefer small, high-impact teams over large, process-heavy environments

It’s ideal for someone who notices broken assumptions early, treats ambiguity as raw material, and raises the bar through example rather than process.

Estamos construindo um banco de talentos com foco em profissionais de Desenvolvimento Java , em diferentes níveis de senioridade (Júnior, Pleno, Sênior e Especialista/Tech Lead ), que desejam atuar em projetos desafiadores, ambientes de alta performance e contextos tecnológicos inovadores.

  • Interesse por inovação e desafios tecnológicos.
